# Carport Permit

> Carport Permit (part of GetMyPermit) prepares and lodges building permit and planning approval applications for carports in Perth and Western Australia.

## Pages

- [Carport permits in Perth, done for you.](https://carportpermit.com.au/): Need a carport permit in Perth or WA? We check the setback and frontage rules, prepare the plans and lodge your building permit and planning approval. Fixed price.
- [Carport council approval in WA](https://carportpermit.com.au/carport-council-approval): Do you need council approval for a carport in WA? The difference between planning approval and a building permit, what triggers each, and how long they take.
- [Carports in the front setback](https://carportpermit.com.au/carport-in-front-setback): Can you build a carport in front of your house in WA? How the R-Codes' 60% frontage rule and reduced setback work, and what Perth councils add.
- [Retrospective carport approval in WA](https://carportpermit.com.au/retrospective-carport-approval): Carport built without a permit in WA? How retrospective approval works, the common front-setback issues, and how we handle it for you.
- [What size carport can you build without approval?](https://carportpermit.com.au/carport-size-without-approval): In WA the permit exemption stops at 10 m² and 2.4 m high, too small for a car, so every real carport needs a building permit. The size rules for planning approval explained.
- [Carport council approval cost in Perth](https://carportpermit.com.au/carport-approval-cost-perth): Carport approval in Perth usually costs about $183 in council fees and levies in 2026-27. When planning approval adds $147, verge permits and bonds, and worked examples.
- [Carport vs garage](https://carportpermit.com.au/carport-vs-garage): Carport or garage? Both need a building permit in WA, but carports can usually sit much closer to the street. Setbacks, boundaries, doors and cost compared.
- [Guides](https://carportpermit.com.au/guides): Free tools and plain-English guides to carports approvals in Perth and Western Australia, checked against the official rules.
- [Our prices, upfront](https://carportpermit.com.au/pricing): Upfront, fixed prices for carports in Perth and WA, with council fees included. Carport from $990.
